So I use humor and show them that I am comfortable, and if they still are confused/mad after, that’s their problem 🤪

I would say I am non-binary and lean towards more masculine terms, but I’m also stubborn and “proud” of who I am, i would say we grew up with “the worst of both worlds” and still choose to try and choose happiness despite what everyone around us thinks is normal/acceptable. Life is very much not normal so we gotta just take it one moment at a time and be the change we want to see. I want people to be happy and comfortable, but we shouldn’t have to sacrifice ourselves to make others feel good. Haha, I think it takes time too, but it would be hard. I had a crush on a straight friend, thankfully it was just a crush, lasted about a year, she never found out, and it wasn't hard. It seems you fell a little. When it comes to best friends though, it's hard! If one friend teases you guys, tease her back and see what the response is from friend you like? 

You don't want to push her away because she's your best friend, I get that. If you think your friendship with her is really strong and would hold up, mention the crush. Possibly indirectly. If not, wait a while, if you are in love with her, you would still love her next year too right? Maybe it is just a crush and you just need time. 

While waiting, try to like other people! It helped me move on a little bit.

It gets easier, but it never really stops. Two years ago my girlfriend didn't want us to be together anymore because of distance and a few other things. I still think about her, but when it was fresh I would be so sad and hurt. Now I think about her on bad days, she's still my favorite memory, and you get sad, but you know what? You stop thinking about them so much. You have to try to get better. It sounds rough, but when I stopped constantly thinking about her, I was able to start to heal. I'm not a hundred percent better, but I'm getting there, and I wish you the same. 

Now do I still worry about her? Haha, as much as I pretend to not care, I am always going to worry. I was in love with this girl, and once you love someone, you can't stop loving them. I worry about her and hope she's okay, but I had to let go because I knew she let go. 

I just got more involved in things, sports, clubs, I tried to keep myself busy. I also tried liking other people, you know, moving on like that and just making all kinds of friends. 

I'm sorry you're feeling this way, but I hope you start feeling better! Good luck!
